In --opgrip, `afield` is initialized once (:1948) and NEVER stepped (every vadapt_field_step call lives AFTER the `continue` at :2764, in the production decode path). `session_seed` (:1946) is a fixed string. So recon_err = L2(fixed_proto, fixed_feature) = CONSTANT across all 200 ticks → calibration median |Δrecon_err|≈0 → g_surp = -1.0 via the `sms<0.002` branch (:2721) → gs_use=0 → surp_phasic≡0.5 (:2724) → idle_surp byte-identical to prod → e_surp==e_live every tick → og_h_surp_mid=0 → surp_degen=true (:3299) → the exact H_9210 ⚙️INSTRUMENT-FAIL(AXIS-DEGENERATE) verdict at :3302. Content-driven signal requires a real g_text — hence --opgrip-live.

EDIT 1 (new flag) — cli/anima.hexa:2002. Above `let og_measure = anima_has_flag(anima_collect_argv(args()), "--opgrip")` add `let og_live = anima_has_flag(anima_collect_argv(args()), "--opgrip-live")`, then make og_measure fire for either: `let og_measure = anima_has_flag(..., "--opgrip") || og_live`. So --opgrip-live reuses the ENTIRE existing opgrip arm/scoring/verdict machinery; it only swaps the recon_err SOURCE + adds a real decode.
